cwe_content.cwe: CWE-74,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

candidate.Reason: The display method executes Velocity content without proper isolation/sandboxing when displaying object fields. This allows injection of malicious Velocity macros that can lead to remote code execution.
Sets the context document (sdoc) to the object's owner document, potentially allowing execution in a different security context than intended.
Calls getRenderedContent on potentially untrusted field content without proper sanitization, enabling injection of malicious wiki syntax.
Directly appends field content without sanitization when not using 1.0 syntax, potentially allowing HTML/script injection.
Wraps content in HTML macro with clean="false" and wiki="false", disabling security protections and allowing raw HTML execution.
Directly evaluates Velocity content without proper sandboxing or validation, allowing execution of arbitrary Velocity macros.
Processes object data and formats it using Velocity evaluation, potentially allowing injection through object field values.
Creates Velocity context with object property values and evaluates header/content templates, enabling Velocity injection through object properties.
